data.title: Signal path with a reflection
data.source:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100%" viewBox="0 0 680 270" role="img">
<title>Signal path: driver, transmission line and load</title>
<desc>Three labelled parts. A, the driver with a 50 ohm source resistance; B, the line with characteristic impedance Z0 of 50 ohms and delay TD; C, a 150 ohm load. Solid arrows carry the incident wave from A to C; the dashed arrow carries the reflection from C back to A.</desc>
<defs>
<marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="context-stroke" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></marker>
</defs>
<g class="c-blue">
<rect x="40" y="60" width="150" height="80" rx="8" stroke-width="0.5"/>
<text class="th" x="115" y="88" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">A · Driver</text>
<text class="ts" x="115" y="112" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Rs = 50 Ω</text>
</g>
<g class="c-teal">
<rect x="265" y="60" width="150" height="80" rx="8" stroke-width="0.5"/>
<text class="th" x="340" y="88" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">B · Line</text>
<text class="ts" x="340" y="112" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Z0 = 50 Ω, delay TD</text>
</g>
<g class="c-coral">
<rect x="490" y="60" width="150" height="80" rx="8" stroke-width="0.5"/>
<text class="th" x="565" y="88" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">C · Load</text>
<text class="ts" x="565" y="112" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">RL = 150 Ω</text>
</g>
<line x1="192" y1="100" x2="261" y2="100" class="arr" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<line x1="417" y1="100" x2="486" y2="100" class="arr" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<text class="ts" x="227" y="86" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">incident</text>
<path d="M565 142 Q565 196 500 196 L180 196 Q115 196 115 146" class="arr" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
<text class="ts" x="340" y="222" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">reflection: Γ = (RL − Z0) / (RL + Z0) = 0.5</text>
<text class="ts" x="340" y="244" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">half of the incident step returns toward A after TD</text>
</svg>
data.purpose: Shows where the reflection comes from.
data.notice: A launches the step; C reflects half of it back toward A.
data.alt: Three boxes A, B, C joined by arrows, with a dashed arrow back.
